unlinked.info: Buff-slot model that drives every stacking answer above: HP/AC buffs are grouped into columns - 'Primary (AC and HP)' = Courage/Heroism + Skin + Inner Fire + Protection of the Glades; 'Primary (HP-only, requires gem)' = Symbol line; 'Shielding / Talisman' = Shaman Talisman + int-caster Shielding + Armor of Protection; 'HP (Strength)' = Divine Vigor/Glory/Strength + Ranger Strength of Nature. Buffs under the same heading cannot stack; combination buffs (Aegolism) block every column they combine.

AC is slotted separately from HP: AC slot 1 = Courage/Heroism + Skin lines; AC slot 2 = Yaulp + int-caster Shielding + druid/ranger coat line + Armor of Protection; AC slot 3 = Call of Earth, Augment/Augmentation, Frenzy; AC slot 4 = Aegis line (incl. Spirit Armor) + Shaman Guardian line + Enchanter Shield line + Magician Phantom line. A Paladin can therefore run Courage-line AC and Aegis-line AC and Yaulp AC simultaneously - three separate AC slots.

Aegolism's implementation is a hard block, not a comparison: 'Block new spell if slot 3 is effect Max Hitpoints and < 1100'. That is why an Aegolism'd target refuses Symbol buffs and Protection of the Glades.

'Blessing of the Page' / 'Blessing of the Squire' (named in the anchor set) are not Paladin spells - on Legends they are Cleric spells (Blessing of the Squire = Cleric 16, a heal-proc buff). No member of that line appears in the Paladin file, so it is not tagged here.

Live-era Paladin spells inside Legends' level range that are absent from the Legends Paladin list and whose line membership could not be verified: Salve (1), Light of Life (52), Force of Akera (53), Quellious' Word of Tranquility (54), Austerity (55, described as an HP and AC buff - probably a Courage-line member between Valor and Resolution), Holy Aura (55), Breath of Tunare (56), Guard of Piety (56), Blessing of Austerity (58).

Paladin disciplines on live (Resistant 51, Fearless 54, Holyforge 55, Deflection 59, Sanctification 60) are not spells and are correctly absent from a spell table; noted only so their absence is not mistaken for a gap.

Level offsets: Legends' Paladin levels match the live Allakhazam Paladin list almost exactly (Cease 7, Desist 13, Reanimation 22, Divine Vigor 35, Wave of Life 39, Valor of Marr 44, Thunder of Karana 47, Brell's Steadfast Aegis 49, Instill 54, Improved Invis to Undead 63), NOT the P99 classic list, which is 2-9 levels later on almost every shared spell. Legends is best modelled as the post-classic Paladin list truncated near 63.

General rule for Paladins buffing in a mixed group: cast Symbol (HP-only slot) and Aegis-line AC freely; do not cast Courage-line buffs over a Druid/Ranger Skin buff or a Shaman's Inner Fire, and never over Protection of the Glades or Aegolism.

openQuestions: Brell's Steadfast Aegis (49): does it share the HP (Strength) slot with Divine Vigor/Glory/Strength? Allakhazam's description calls it 'a group spell along the same lines as Divine Glory', which implies a conflict, but no slot-level source confirms it. If they do conflict, a Paladin cannot run Brell's + Divine Strength together and the Legends buff advice changes materially.

Divine Favor (55): the P99 Buff Lines Damage Absorption table omits it entirely, so it is unknown whether it shares the Rune/skin absorb slot with Enchanter Rune I-V and Necromancer/Wizard skin absorbs.

Reckless Strength (18) / Frenzied Strength (52): not listed on the P99 Buff Lines page; their slot relative to the Strength (Primary) line (Spirit Strength, Storm Strength, Strength) is unverified. Legends' own effect text for Reckless Strength contains player-written commentary ('Yaulp becomes better here', 'Click off before the last 40sec'), which suggests the effect string was hand-edited rather than generated.

Instrument of Nife (15) vs Divine Might (45): both are 'add melee proc' self buffs. Do they overwrite each other, and do they overwrite other classes' proc buffs? No classic source found; the one-proc-per-character assumption is inferred.

Divine Vigor (35) and Divine Glory (53) both read +100 Max HP on Legends, making Divine Glory pointless. Community reporting on the live spell puts Divine Vigor near +50. Is the Legends value intentional (a re-tier) or a data error?

Revive (39) shows no experience restoration while Reparation (31) restores 20% and Renewal (49) restores 50%. Is Revive genuinely a 0% corpse summon slotted at 39, or is the Legends effect string incomplete?
Remove Lesser Curse (34) and Remove Curse (45) both read 'Decrease Curse Counter by 4'. What actually differentiates them on Legends?
The Legends file contains two records for Invisibility versus Undead at level 17 with different casing, effects and target types. Which is canonical?
'Instill' (54) is almost certainly the classic 'Enstill' (root). Should the Legends name be treated as canonical or as a typo in the mirror? Its record also has no effects array.

Legends grants Paladins the full Cleric magic-DD line (Strike/Furor/Smite/Wrath/Retribution). Is this intentional server design, or has Cleric data leaked into the Paladin table? No classic or live source gives Paladins these spells.

Legends' Yaulp I-III are recorded as 'Permanent' duration where classic Yaulp is a short self buff. If accurate, the Yaulp upgrade order is inverted in practice (permanent Yaulp III beats a 4-tick Yaulp IV for uptime).
